about: CTAN (Comprehensive TeX Archive Network): browse TeX/LaTeX packages, topics, contributors, announcements, licenses, archive directories, ratings and comments from the public ctan.org web pages and their XHR endpoints.

commands.summary: List CTAN packages whose name starts with a given letter (package slug and URL)
Get a package's detail page: title and catalogue entry table (version, license, home page, etc.)

params.name: pkg
params.description: Package key, e.g. pgfplots. Aliases such as tikz redirect to the owning package (pgf)

commands.summary: Get a package's release timeline as [year, month, version] tuples
Get a package's rating breakdown: the number of votes for each star level
List user comments on a package (commenter, profile link, date), paginated

params.name: offset
params.description: Page index, starting at 0 (the UI increments it by 1 per page)

commands.summary: List all topics with slug, URL and a tooltip containing the description and package count
List topics ranked by number of packages
List the packages in a topic

params.name: topic
params.description: Topic slug from list-topics, e.g. biomedical, font-sample

commands.summary: List top contributors with their package counts
List contributors whose surname starts with a given letter
List the packages maintained by a contributor

params.name: id
params.description: Contributor id: the last segment of /author/{id} URLs

commands.summary: List the latest CTAN-ann announcements (package uploads and updates)
Get the full text of an announcement and the package it concerns

params.name: msgid
params.description: Message id: the last path segment of /ctan-ann/id/... links

commands.summary: List all announcements for one package
List subdirectories and files (size, date, download URL) in a CTAN archive directory

params.name: path
params.description: Archive path without a leading slash, e.g. graphics/pgf/contrib/pgfplots

commands.summary: List the license keys used in the TeX Catalogue (free and non-free)
Get a license's name, text and reference link

params.name: key
params.description: License key from list-licenses, e.g. mit, gpl3, lppl1.3c

commands.summary: Get how many packages use a license, out of the total package count
Get monthly CTAN upload counts as [year, month, count] tuples
Get a random featured package (key, name, caption, description)
